blocks.text: SOP: preventative maintenance checklist, bay 1-4

This is the working cut for RDW-2204 on July 14, 2022. Cal Dreher asked for a written bound after the current path (Verbal PM, sheets in a drawer) stopped being honest. I am Jeilen Jones, Shop Helper, writing for Cal Dreher, Nina Soto, and Hank Morel. Primary host shop.ridgeway.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on dash-light PM instead of the sheet, then open questions. If you are on the floor next shift, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the steps.

Sheet per bay. Oil, filter, belts, leaks, lights. Initial each line. No 'looked fine' as a line. I am not restating a hallway yes. dash-light PM instead of the sheet is out because June 22 truck came back in 11 days with a belt Cal had not initialed. Sheet would have shown the skip. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: bays=4, days=11, lines=18, weeks=3, belts=1, oil=15W40, skip=1, drawer=1. Sibling tickets RDW-SOP-2022-011 and RDW-2204-QA. I will not reopen dash-light PM instead of the sheet in a side thread because someone asked for a rate waiver. Nina Soto is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.

blocks.text: Background. Why the current path is the wrong tool

Hank Morel owns a leftover that is easy to skip: parts.ridgeway.internal. I will ping once. After that the owner is late, not blocked. Unique to this file (33): refuse on dash-light PM instead of the sheet, lock is sheet, initials, no dash-light as PM. I will not hide a process change inside a 'quick align' on RDW-SOP-2022-011.
If it is not on the sheet, it did not happen. A green light on the dash is not a PM.

What a skeptical lead would try first on shop.ridgeway.internal: the path Cal Dreher actually has, not an empty-tote photo. Metric I will argue is a clean confirm, not a vanity units-per-hour. If we cannot show that path on bay-01.ridgeway.internal with the numbers already in this file, we do not have a cut. Jeilen Jones will not accept a hallway yes as that proof.
